about: What AND, OR and XOR make of text typed as an argument (ADR-0047): the seventeenth Windows run read Excel's AND("abc",TRUE) as TRUE (AND-011), so text that spells neither TRUE nor FALSE is passed over, as text inside a range is. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' LogicalArgumentTests.

ADR-0047 (AND-011, the seventeenth Windows run): typed text that spells no truth is passed over: =AND(TRUE,"abc",FALSE)
ADR-0047 (AND-011, the seventeenth Windows run): typed text that spells no truth is passed over: =AND("",1)
